name: Túrricse (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of green and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Túrricse (a red, white and green shield with a house and a wavy stripe, within a wreath of oak) below the name TÚRRICSE in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
